nodes.title: J2 replays 2 and 3 (her reply sentence on returning to an aside), run by main. Replay 2 on Brain 16b0f0fcc (the note carries the child's words, not their sentence): 50 of 60 pass the predicate, but 13 of c5's passes repeat the child's real sentence (it still reached the model through the turn's history, and the replay read echo against the chosen words), so 37 of 60 clean; c6 12 of 20 with 5 refused on the word 'har' and 3 on a bare 'hota hai'. Replay 3 on Brain 4c87cafeb (the child's line cut from the reply call; lesson and rule clauses narrowed for this sentence only): 4 exchanges x 20 = 80 drafts, 76 clean (18, 20, 20, 18), no echo, $0.071. Simulated child, one seed, three child sentences. The replay shows safe and on-topic, not well-written: no judge has read the sentences.

Judging of the old games catalogue stops after batch 1 (1 of 10 stored by two Opus judges under rubric v2: 6 give the answer away, 4 state a wrong fact; 3 more of the 66 fail the tick predicate; the earlier sample was 4 of 20). The scripted topics' games are regenerated through the approval lane instead (digits rule, tick predicate, per-topic how), one per scripted topic, generated by main under a $0.25 cap and judged by two judges with predicates run first. Reverse if: regenerated pieces pass at no better a rate than the old ones over the first 10.
